en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large crowd gathered in a central market square surrounded by multi‑story historic buildings decorated with wreaths and vertical striped flags. Many people wear traditional clothing and hats, forming a procession or festival in the square. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin and some business signs are visible on the façades.
